in_hebrew.name: Howell
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Smoke and well
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Howell הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Howell is derived from the Old English words ‘hoh’ meaning ‘smoke’ and ‘weal’ meaning ‘well’. It is a name that suggests a connection to the natural world, with the smoke perhaps representing the breath of life, and the well symbolizing the sustenance and nourishment that comes from the earth.
